batting.name: DJ Harris
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b M Morkel

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c S Nadeem b VR Aaron

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b VR Aaron

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c CL White b S Dhawan

balls.text: four more to end the innings, it was a full-toss, a low one at that and Duminy has only timed it away through extra-cover for a four...

goes for a pull, shorter ball and that is top-edged by White, goes in the air towards the square-leg region, Ojha runs from behind the stumps, as do some of the players on the leg side, but in the end, it is the wicket-keeper who pouches it.
length ball, outside the off stump, goes for a heave, gets another inside edge and goes to short mid-wicket, they are away for a quick single
short, slow, goes for a pull, seems to have hit some part of the body, goes off the bounce to the keeper
outside the off stump, pitched right up and beats the outside edge
outside the off stump, another full-toss but only tapped away for a single
finally gets the yorker right after all those full-tosses, drilled down to long-off for a single
full-toss outside the off stump, wanted to swing it away, but fails to get it in the middle of the bat, a single to the leg side
full-toss on his pads yet again and this time he can get it to deep square-leg only, a run taken
full toss on his pads, for a moment it looked like he was going to let that go, before flicking it to deep fine-leg for a couple
down the leg side and White could have easily got some bat on that for a four down to fine-leg, instead he misses and the umpire flexes his arms
outside the off stump, full-toss, wanted to give himself room, but gets a bottom edge and they can get only a single
Shot, six more to White, he continues to plunder the opposition, it was pitched up to the bat and he goes over the bowler, swings his arms for a six!
full-toss, outside the off stump and that is drilled back over the bowler for a four! The stand may have been broken but the fours flow
slower ball, outside the off stump, pushed to short cover to rotate the strike

run-out for 84! Pitched right up, bit of swing into the batsman, drills it to the right of fine-leg for a single and they come back for a second. The fielder throws down the stumps direct from deep fine-leg though and Dhawan is miles away, end of one of the better innings in this format!
slower ball from Pathan, very, very slow in fact, bit of bounce and Dhawan, for once, misses the slog hit.
slower outside the off stump, tries to hit it over the long-off but gets a single to the fielder
what? Six again? Yes it is! And what a stroke to get it, almost like he was slog-sweeping a spinner, it was a length ball, slower and he heaves it high and long over mid-wicket!
through the point field for a four now! Pitched right up to the bat, outside the off stump, and he is able to dig it away for a boundary!
slower one, outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat, to third-man for a single
driven a length ball to long-on for a single now

what a shot off one of the best bowlers of the tournament, he moved around in his crease, finished up outside the off stump, the ball was searing into the middle, got some bat on it over fine-leg for four!
full-toss, dabbed it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
pitched right up, driven to deep mid-wicket for a single
goes down the pitch, beaten by the lack of pace, chips it over to long-on and they come back for the second, excellent running
heaved away over deep mid-wicket for a six! White's begun to turn it on now, it was shorter, cleared his feet and smacked over the fielder for a maximum
wide outside the off stump, takes it from there and tries to smash him down the ground but can get it to long-off for only a single
goes down the track, pulls up the length a bit and driven to long-off
goes down the track, tapped it to the leg side and they take one, rush back for the second, with the fielder from deep needing to run into the circle to field that one
on his pads, flicked away to long-on for another single
pitched outside the off stump, fuller and driven to long-off for a single
slower ball, shorter too and that is pulled away to the fence for a four, it is raining away at Hyderabad, and I mean boundaries
flicked it away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
smack, through point for another four! That was not hit in the air and beat a diving point fielder within the circle
short ball, goes over the point fielder for a four! Gave himself room did White and got it through easily!
short ball, stylishly flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
goes down the pitch again, drilled over the point region but goes to the deep fielder for a single

full-toss, did not look like he was getting it in the middle of the bat, but still managed to get it over the mid-off fielder who was up in the circle, and despite Warner's best efforts from long-on that goes for a four
on the middle stump, squared him up a little, gets a bit of the outside edge for a single
on the middle stump, keeps a little low, defended on the leg side
on his pads, tucked away to fine-leg for a four, this wasn't the best of deliveries and gently played away through the fine-leg region with the fielder up in the circle.
four more and that makes it 16 off that over! Outside the off stump and cut away to the point fence for a four.
six and a half-century for Dhawan! This was pitched up this time, he tries to get under the ball by moving around in the crease, gets it right and smacks it over long-on for a six!
outside the off stump and heaved away to long-on for a four, there was a player in place at wide long but he did not get there in time!
on the middle stump, slower, on good length, driven to long-off for a single
full-toss, driven to the long-on for a single
short of length, bit of bounce and and he tries to cut it away, but goes to the fielder at short cover
on the off stump, bit of movement from White in the crease, but decides to tap it back to the bowler
goes down the track, this on the leg stump, takes it on the full and drives it to long-on
six more from Dhawan! The line was changed to the middle stump and he has swept it away for a six, over backward square-leg
down the track and slammed! Six for Dhawan, who continues to exhibit a lot of form, it was outside the off-stump, allowing him to free his arms
goes down the track, taps it to mid-wicket and wanted to go for the second run, but Nagar rushes in quickly and prevents that
pitched right up, driven to long-on for a single
short of length, wanted to cut it away but got the toe end of the bat, just loops over the point fielder for a single
slower one and it almost turns back into the batsman, gets an inside-edge as well and misses the off stump!
low full-toss, outside the off stump, driven but to the short cover fielder
outside the off stump, goes for an expansive cut and the excessive bounce defeats the batsman
flicked away, with a lot of bottom hand and that has easily bisected the area between deep square-leg and long-on. Dhawan's showing some fine stroke-play here
shorter but quite slow as well, tries to pull it away, but only to the fielder at deep square-leg
tapped away to the off side yet again and this time they are off for a quick single
on the off stump, turning away, defended to the off side
swept and pretty hard at that, to a ball on his leg stump, and for most part it looked like going to the fence, fielded really well by Russell at fine-leg
shorter this time, goes on to his back foot, pushes it to the long-off fieleder
turn and bounce outside the off stump, White was going for a push, beats him
on the leg stump, from round the stumps, tries to sweep it, hits the pads and they are off for a single
bouncer attempted, pulls it away to the fine-leg fielder for a single by Dhawan
outside the off stump, short of length, driven through mid-off for a single
on the off stump, good length and White defends it back to the bowler
slower ball, outside the off stump, opened he face of the bat to third man for a single
swung away over mid-wicket for a six! What a shot from Dhawan, it was good length outside the off stump and Dhawan slapped it away for the maximum
pitched up, driven to long-off for a single
on the stump, bit short, turning away from the batsman and pushed to the off side for a single
paddle sweep for four! White's started off really well here, upper flicks it over the wicket-keeper for a four!
goes down the pitch, gets no timing on it and is able to get it through to long-on for only a single
outside the leg stump, spinning further down the leg side, swept but to the short fine-leg fielder
down the wicket, wanted to slam it over the boundary, but did not get too much bat on it, landed to the left of the deep square-leg fielder
round the wicket, on the middle stump, pushed to the leg side
short ball and pulled away by White for four! It did not have too much pace, sat there to be hit and that is spanked away for a boundary
and this time he is able to flick it away through fine-leg for a four, bad ball, going down the leg side and he only needed to get some bat
this time it is going away from the batsman, is sucked into playing at it, misses, bit of an appeal for a caught-behind but aborted
swung back and hit White! The batsman was trying to run it down to third-man but it not only jagged back but also got some bounce and cracks into his gloves. Ouch!
pitched up to the bat, driven to mid-off and the fielder hits it direct at the non-striker's end. Appeal but the third umpire is not called for
goes down the track but can only push it to short cover
on the middle stump, tapped to the leg side by the in form Cameron White
pulled and caught! He had just got a boundary through the covers and went for another aggressive pull this time, did not get in the middle of the bat and is caught at short mid-wicket!
fuller, almost a full-toss, 137.8 km/hr and dug out to point by the batsman
driven and four! It was over-pitched from Aaron and Sangakkara brought his foot out and drove it through extra-cover for a four
short of good length, decent pace and the batsman had to go on to his back foot, defended back
outside the off stump, good length and he bends his legs to steer it through to third-man
outside the off stump, pitched on length, driven towards the mid-off region but fielded by the bowler to his right

driven and gone, caught at short cover! This was not pitched up, short of good length, the batsman wanted to drive it through the covers but could not get it in the middle and it goes straight to the fielder, held easily
quicker this time, on to the back foot and defended to the off side
slower ball from Morkel, 126.3 km/hr, Harris needed to adjust to the slowness of that delivery and defends it to the off side
edged away and for a four! That is the second edge for Harris that has gone for a boundary, outside the off stump, went for a cut and it goes over the slip in place, Sehwag
pitched right up to the batsman, tries to drive it, bottom of the bat and driven back to the bowler
and again, coming from round the wicket, bit of angle into the batsman, tries to cut it but beaten for pace.
some bounce, some pace, and it beats Dhawan from round the wicket. Wanted to cut it away but took him by surprise and he misses it.
outside the off stump, short of good length, wanted to cut it, but does not get any timing on it
just outside off stump, deviating slightly away, gets an outside edge through to the third-man region for a single
top-edged and four! Beaten for toss, wanted to pull but did not get anywhere close to the middle of the bat and it goes over the head of the wicket-keeper
short of good length ball, does not bounce as much as the batsman expected, inside edge on to the pads
pitched up to the bat and driven to the off side to the mid-off fielder, end of a good Morkel over
length ball on the middle stump, defended on the leg side
pitched right up to the batsman this time, almost yorker-length, defended and the inside edge bounces around on the off-side for a single
length ball, on the off stump, defended by Harris, yby jabbin the bat quickly down
outside the off stump, length ball, tries to drive through the covers, but gets an outside edge through to third-man for a single
short of length, tries to cut it away but goes to the third-man
poor ball that, drifts down the leg side after the field was changed to bring the fine-leg up in the circle, nudges it through the right of the fielder and it goes to the fence.
goes down the pitch, takes it on the full and drives it crisply through mid-off, left of the fielder and it gushes through to the fence
on the off stump, it is not coming on to the bat, driven to mid-on for no run.
this time a little fuller and driven to mid-on but the fielder was not right back and they cannot take any run
again within the stumps, good length ball and pushed to the short cover for no run.
pitched on a good length, brings the batsman forward and Dhawan defends it to the off side. Not too much pace on that one
bouncer in retaliation, but Harris sees it pass through harmlessly to the wicket-keeper
straight driven for four! Pitched slightly up to the bat and Harris has pushed it through to the left of mid-on for another four
outside the off stump and pitched full again, tries to drive it through the covers but hits the bottom of the bat
pulls his length back, nips in after hitting the seam, tried to cut it away but misses completely
pitched up yet again and this time it is drilled through the covers for four. A bit of out-swing but Harris wasn't letting that one go
outside the off stump, swinging away, pitched up and driven gently into the covers
finishes in style, punched that good length ball over the straight boundary for a six!
short one and that has been hit over mid-off for a four, did not seem to get the middle of the bat but still goes over
pushed to the leg side, to short mid-wicket
shorter one, pulled away to short mid-wicket
six more, that is a short again and that has been spanked for the seventh time over the square-leg boundary by Warner!
cut away for a couple of runs to third-man

six and century! What a way to get to your first 100 this season, second in the IPL and fifth in T20 cricket! In fact, it was a short ball, and Warner pulls it over the square-leg field for a six, immediately knows it is going!
outside the off stump, tapped away for a single
shorter one, tried to pull it, but kept low and is able to get it away for a single to the leg side
from round the wicket, quicker from the bowler, tried to pull it away, misses, and there was a loud appeal, but pitched outside the leg stump
outside the off stump, short of length, pushed to the off side and that is a rare dot ball.
round the wicket, angling in, tapped away to fine-leg for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven to wide long-on and that has gone to the fence! What a shot off a good delivery, misfielded a tad but that is how it is with Deccan!
inside edge and it does not rush away to the fence, the fielder runs towards the ball to stop it from going to the fence. It was outside the off stump and he was going for a cut
on his pads, slower, played it to the off side and this time they get no run
short ball and that has been sent on its way to deep square-leg for a six, a century beckons for Warner here and he is getting there in a hurry!
outside the off stump, tapped away for a single to bring up the 150-run stand off only 84 balls!
short of length, on the back foot, punched to the off side for a single
flatter, quicker and spins away a little, beats the bat
pitched up and driven over the in-field for a six! It was a googly but that was very easily read by the batsman
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and they are able to get two again
the run glut continues, Mishra floats it up and Ojha has smacked it over mid-wicket for a six!
outside the off stump, driven to the sweeper and they run away for a single
slower one, tapped away to mid-wicket and they are away for a very quick two!
pitched up, smashes it straight back over the bowler, but fielded well by Gony and they get only a single
another slower one, Warner waited for and gave it a spanking, the deep square-leg fielder dived for it, but got nowhere near and that goes for a four!
another slower one, very wide as well, went for the cut but mistimes it and almost goes on the full to the sweeper fielder, one bounce in fact
outside the off stump, slower ball, opens the face of the bat and played to short third-man
on the pads this time, played away to the leg side for a single
quicker outside the off stump, goes through to the keeper as he tried to cut it but missed
outside the off stump, floated up in the air, swept away to long-on for a single
short ball, quicker and no turn, tries to pull it away, gets an inside edge to the pads
goes down the pitch, driven to long-on for a single
on the off stump, turning away from the bat, gets an outside edge through the slips for a couple of runs
short ball, slower I think and it has been dispatched over square-leg for a six! That was only a swivel, not even a pull and it still easily carries over the deep field
short ball again and Warner tries to pull it away, hits high on the bat, mistimed and just above the mid-wicket fielder for a couple
bouncer, Warner was swaying away, before deciding at the last moment to upper cut it, misses and the keeper collects
short of length outside the off stump, tapped away to the third-man fielder for a single
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it through to third-man for a couple of runs.
short ball, down the leg side, left alone and that is easily a wide
length ball, defended on the back foot to the leg side

short ball, pulled away and straight to the deep square-leg fielder, Ankit Sharma, misfields and allows it to go through for a four. There was a bit of curl on that but that should have been easily stopped
quicker, flatter, outside the off stump, easily cut away for a couple of runs
staying low on the off stump, goes on the back foot, tapped away to point
pitched up to the bat, flicked away to the leg side for a single, doing it well now
swept away to short fine-leg for a single
slogged away for a couple of runs to deep square-leg
and this is two in a row, again pitched up, Ojha went down the track and smacks it over the straight fielder for a biggie!
goes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it over the bowler for a six! That almost came out of nowhere!
good length on the off stump, punched to the covers
pitched up, very full, driven to long-on for only a single
down the leg side, tries to nudge it away, misses and that is called a wide
outside the off stump, tries to slog it over, but the inside-edge to the leg side
short of length, on the back foot, defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump, gently tapped away to the region between long-on and deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Well run by both the batsmen
outside the off stump, googly, picked up well, tapped away for a single
leg spinner, turning rather well, wanted to pull it away and in the end, manages to do it for a run
short ball, goes to his back foot and crashes it through point for a couple of runs. Duminy needed to slide and tidy it up
pitched up to the bat, driven to long-off for a single
edged away for a four through the slips region, but it was a no-ball. Mishra seems to have bowled a no-ball, but it was cutting the bowling crease, Free Hit called
outside the off stump, pitched right up, driven to the sweeper region for a single
outside the off stump, tapped away to the off side and the single that follows brings up his half-century!
outside the off stump, good length ball and that hits the pitch and jumps up disconcertingly at the batsman, beats the outside edge
outside the off stump, pitched right up, tries to drive it but does not time it too well
on his pads again, this time it is Warner and he seems to have flicked it away to the fine-leg for a four to bring up his fifty, but wait, it is called leg-byes again!
outside the off stump, good length, opens the face of the bat through to third-man for a single
on his pads, down the leg side and flicked away to fine-leg for four, there was a long-leg in place but not as fine as that. Called leg-byes
full-toss, outside the off stump and drilled through the covers for a four! Warner's turning it on here but more vitally, the bowling has been below par.
on the off stump, fuller, driven to mid-off and he wanted a single, but sent back
outside the off stump, this time it is guided through the gap between point and short third-man, and for four.
short and hooked away for a six! That is poor bowling, two successive short balls, one cut away and this one is pulled over fine-leg for the second successive six of the over
blazed away over the covers for a four, it was short and wide and that was very easily done, almost nonchalantly !
short of length, gives himself room but can get it only to mid-on on the bounce
short of good length yet again and defended on the back foot, back to the bowler
short ball, pace, bounce and beats the cut shot. Ojha hasn't got too many in the middle of his bat and that has zipped through to the keeper
short ball, but does not rise too much, defended back to the bowler
on the middle, comes on to the front foot, defends it to mid-on
on the off stump, pitched right up, angling away, taps it to the off side and goes for a quick run
pitched right up, and the batsman on-drives it to deep square for a single
width, outside the off stump and that has been smashed through the covers for a four! Warner's doing what Sehwag has done to bowlers all tournament long!
flicked away to short fine-leg but straight to the fielder
short ball and slapped away over square-leg for a six! It was not a poor ball by any stretch but Warner's looking in that kind of a mood tonight, going after everything his way.
good length, on the back foot, tapped it close to the leg side and they are away for a quick single
on his pads, tucks it away to fine-leg, but the fielder is up inside the circle and the deep square-leg has to tidy up
short of good length, moving away from the bat, tries to dab it to third-man but misses

loud, loud appeal for an lbw, thudded into the pad, but the umpire seems to think that it was hitting outside the off stump, or angling away, either way, it was close but not-out. Pitched up, he was on the back foot and missed the bat
on the middle stump, nudged away to mid-wicket for a single
short of length, defended on the back foot and it is fielded by Gony on his follow-through
outside the off stump, pitched right up, goes for a drive, gets an outside edge to the third-man for a single
tries to pull it away, horizontal bat shot, bit of a top edge and it just evades Sangakkara at mid-on, a false stroke but does not go to hand
on the middle stump, pitched right up, Warner was lining up for a big one but in the end, defended back to the bowler
outside the off stump, defended on the front foot by Ojha
on his pads, tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, angling away from the batsman and he misses it
well bowled on that Free Hit, yorker length, Warner was trying go over the top, but jabbed down in time
outside the off stump, and Warner cuts it away to point, that should have been fielded by Dhawan, missed and it goes through for a four. It is a no-ball too so we have a Free Hit coming up
short of good length, dabbed away to deep square-leg for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up, defended on the off side to covers
pitched fuller again and Warner smashes it through the covers for another four, the fourth of the innings!
short this time and cut away by Warner to open his account with a four.
outside the off stump, a tad quicker, pushed to the off side
flights it up to the bat, goes for a drive, probably hits an under edge and goes between the legs of the keeper!

gone, Sehwag's gone, caught rather well! It is that partnership again, Dhawan and White, floated it up, went for a slog over long-on, gets an outside edge that went over the covers, it seemed to be going away, White ran after it, dived and pulls off an excellent catch!
pitched right up and Sehwag is wasting no time, he has drilled it over mid-off for a four. It was right up to the batsman!
